card.name: Small words in old biographical prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (as, 's, a, and, to, a comma) in the middle of sentences in historical or biographical writing and quiz lists. They come just before a role, title or description.

modes.label: Biography link words
modes.description: A small word after a person's name or role, leading into a job, title or relation.
modes.example: also became in time one of White<<'s>> most valued correspondents

modes.label: Quiz answer options
modes.description: A letter marker or option word in a multiple-choice list from a book quiz.

modes.label: Old essay phrasing
modes.description: A small word inside long 18th or 19th century sentences.
